chapter.verse: Tua bangin Khris in pumpi tawh gimthuak ahih nungsang, tua bang ngaihsutzia nam tawh na kithadip un. A hang pen pumpi tawh gimthuak peuhpeuh mawhna a tawpsan hi a,
tua pen pumpi tawh a nuntak hun sung teng mihing lunggulhnate zui lo-in Pasian' deihna bangin a nuntak theih nading ahi hi.
A hang pen cilesa paktatna, cilesa lunggulhna, zukhamna, gualnop gamlumna, zununna leh sungnimhuai milim biakna cih bangin Gentile mite' ut namte, a beisa huna na hih uh kicingkhop khin hi.
Hih thu tawh kisai-in tua mite in cilesa uangtatna tuihual sungah na zuih loh uh ciangin lamdang sa uh a, note hong daisak uh hi.
Himah taleh amaute pen a hingte leh a site' tungah thukhen dingin a kigingsa-a om Pasian' kiangah thulela a telgenkik dingte ahi uh hi.

Misite' kiang nangawn Lungdamna Thu a kitangkona zong hih thu hang mah hi a, midangte' thuak bangin pumpi tawh thukhenna thuak uh ahih hangin tua pen Pasian' nuntak bangin kha sungah a nuntak nading uh ahi hi.
Na khempeuh a beina hun hong nai ta hi. Tua ahih manin na thungette uh a muibut nadingin thulam tawnin leh lungsim tei sinsenin om un.
A phadiakin no teng kikal ah nakpi ki-itna na lenkip un. A hang pen itna in mawhna tampi seel hi.
Phun lo-in khatlekhat zinleleng do na siam tek un.
Mi kim in hehpihna gah a kingah tek ahih mah bangin Pasian' hehpihna namkim a kemcing innsung thuvan hoihte bangin khatlekhat kidon nadingin tua thuphate na zang un.

Na khempeuh ah Jesu Khris' tungtawnin Pasian a kiphat theih nadingin a paukhia peuhpeuh Pasian' genkhiat thute a suahkhia hi henla, a sem a bawl peuhpeuh Pasian' sikh thalengal tawh a sem a bawl hita hen. Tua Pasian' tungah a tawntung a tawntungin minpha leh ukzawhna om ta hen. Amen.
Kong itte aw, note' tungah sittelna a haksa mahmah hong tun ciangin thu lamdangpi a piang bang khatin lamdang ngaihsut kei un.
Tuaci lo-in Khris' gimthuaknate a puakpih na hih manun na lungdamzaw un. Tua hileh ama' minphatna a kilat hun ciangin note zong lungdamin na nuam ding uh hi.
Khris' min hangin simmawh na tuah uhleh thuphangah na hi uh hi. A hang pen note' tungah minphatna Kha leh minphatna Pasian hong om ahi hi.
Ahih hangin tualthat, guta, thusia bawl, thusia puak sim cihte tawh gimthuak kuamah na om kei ta un.
Ahi zongin Khristian hihna tawh gimthuak khatpeuh a om leh amah maizum kei henla tua min tawh Pasian phat ta hen.
A hang pen thukhenna hun hong tung ding hita a, Pasian' innkuan tawh hong kipan ding ahi hi. Ei tawh hong kipan ahihleh Pasian' Lungdamna Thu a sanglo mite' lamtawp koici bang ahi ding hiam?
Tua hi a, “Midikte in zong hotkhiat ngah mengmeng lo lai ahihleh kihtakbei misiate leh mawhneite bang suak ding ahi uh hiam?”
Tua ahih manin Pasian' deihna hang tawh gimthuak mite in nahoih a sep laitak mahun amau' nunna khate, a muanhuai Piangsakpa' kiangah ap ta uh hen.
